notes: Full test (BLEO, jauge du 3/11 : 1 full test sur 6). Accroche jamais faite chez nous. Accroches écrites : « the 3-question rule that fixed how i study » (retenue : une règle simple et nommée, qu'on enregistre), « what i ask myself after every single lesson » (écartée : moins nette), « 3 questions that tell you if you actually learned something » (écartée : longue). La règle, vraie et simple : après chaque leçon, se poser trois questions (quoi, pourquoi, et un exemple), puis comment l'appliquer. slides.texte_overlay:
the 3-question rule
that fixed how i study

after every lesson, i close my notes and answer 3 questions.
that's it.

1. what was this lesson about, in one sentence?
if i can't say it simply, i didn't get it.

2. why does it matter?
what does it explain, cause or connect to?

3. can i give one example?
one example from class, one of my own. that's where it sticks.

every evening i answer them for the whole day, notes closed.
10 minutes. no rereading.

phone stays in another room while i do it.
it's only 10 minutes. it deserves my full attention.
the questions i can't answer = exactly what i ask tomorrow
